versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Company Brief skill.
- Generates a concise, role-specific one-page company research brief to prepare candidates for applications and interviews.
- Covers company business model, recent news and trajectory, core products, competitors, likely challenges, culture signals, tailored questions to ask, and personalized interview angles.
- Includes detailed guidance for collecting and structuring input, quality checks, and anti-patterns to ensure briefs are factual, relevant, and actionable.
